## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T09:19Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: acf4cd7347d2a92645d534cfc7be073512f0c067
Card: #34614 · claim 6939422862 · surface amendment 6941237713 · os-dev reports 6941211681, 6941369014, 6943535707 (final, this head)

The time half of the card is built in all four places where the time broke, inside the amended surface. The badge half was measured, found not to reproduce, and is pinned by an e2e control instead of a code change. The one-letter cut the dev did find has its own card (#34696, `Refs`). No must-fix and no should-fix.

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

None.

### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34614`, with `Refs #34696` and no other closing verb. No `!` and no `(narrowing)`, so no dogfood battery is owed. |
| Scope | 6 files: `RecordMetaFooter.tsx` (+10/−3), `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` (+14/−6), `ThreadedReplies.tsx` (+4/−2), the new `narrowDrawerTime-34614.test.tsx`, the new `ui/e2e/narrow-drawer-time-34614.spec.ts` and the changeset. The claim names `RecordMetaFooter.tsx` and "the timeline entry's time element in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/**`". Amendment 6941237713 names `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` and `ThreadedReplies.tsx` explicitly and adds the `ui/e2e/` spec. `HeaderHighlight.tsx` is claimed but not touched, which matches the badge finding. |
| Merge head | `acf4cd73` has parents `2ead419b` and main `77b42a1e` (which carries #34684, the series base). `git show --remerge-diff acf4cd73` is empty. `git diff origin/main...acf4cd73` is the same 6 files, +414/−11, so none of #34595's files ride along. |
| Meta line | `MetaEntry` becomes `inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-1.5`. The dot and the `time` element sit in one `inline-flex … whitespace-nowrap` unit (`data-record-meta-when`). An entry with no actor draws the unit with no dot, as before. |
| Timeline | The entry header and the folded-run header become `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5`, and their time span is `whitespace-nowrap`. The compact system line now draws `' '` and then a nowrap `'· ' + time`. Its text reads " · time", the same as the old `' · '` + time, and the jsdom test pins that it is byte-identical. The reply header in `ThreadedReplies.tsx` gets the same flex-wrap and nowrap time. |
| Badge half | `SelectCellRenderer`'s `Badge` is `max-w-full min-w-0` around an inner `truncate` span with the label as `title`, so a long label ends in an ellipsis inside its own cell. The e2e badge case reads those classes out of `ui/badge.tsx`, `@object-ui/fields` and the `HeaderHighlight.tsx` grid cell at run time. It pins 「方案报价」 whole and a long label ellipsised, with its title, inside the cell, at 380px. That meets card acceptance 1 as written. |
| Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | `no` / `none` in the claim, the amendment, the PR body and the changeset. No export, no key and no locale string. The `data-*` hooks are DOM test hooks, not API. |
| Changeset | `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, the only published package whose `src` moved. "Wide layouts are unchanged: when the row fits, nothing wraps" matches the 900px control. |
| Tests | Real commands with output: plugin-detail 384 files / 3465 tests and type-check on this head, the e2e spec (6 passed) and `type-check:e2e`. The new jsdom file has 7 class-shape pins. The new e2e spec has 6 Chromium geometry cases (380 and 400px for the meta line and the entry header, a 900px control, and the badge case). Each extraction throws if it matches the wrong string. Three ablations, each restored to the HEAD blob. Dropping `flex-wrap` from the meta entry turns the e2e spec red (2 of 6). Dropping it from the activity header also turns it red (2 of 6). Dropping `whitespace-nowrap` from the meta unit turns only the jsdom pin red (2 of 7), and the PR declares why: a ~70px unit in a wrapping row moves whole either way. 38/38 derived gates. No existing test is edited. |
| UI strings | None added. |
| Docs | I searched `content/docs`, `skills` and the plugin-detail README for the meta line's and the timeline header's layout. The README's meta-line paragraph is about which fields it names, not how it wraps. Nothing is made false. |
| Acceptance | 1: the badge is whole or ellipsised with a title (pinned at 380px). 2: "3 days ago" / 「3 天前」 do not break per word (pinned at 380 and 400px; measured before and after in en, de and zh). 3: wide layouts are unchanged (pinned at 900px; block heights match before and after). Card item 4's measured regression test is the e2e spec. |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34732`: NOT governed, 425 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-A. |
| CI on this head | 55 check-runs: 42 `success`, 13 `skipped`, none failed or pending. That includes Test UI 16/16 shards plus the aggregate, Build & E2E UI (which runs the new spec), Live E2E UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, every Type Check and Lint family, Check Changeset, PR-body guards and Governed Surface Queue Guard. Test Core and Build Core are skipped by the path filter. |

### Notes

1. **`Fixes #34614` with the one-letter cut moved.** The card's title symptom ("badge cut to one letter") is real in a narrow drawer, but it comes from `record:path`'s desktop stage row, not from a key-field badge. It is carried by #34696, which o3-A has claimed and is building. The card's acceptance 1 names the badge, and the badge holds, so closing #34614 on this PR is consistent. Whoever reads #34614 after it closes should be pointed at #34696; the PR body's `Refs` line does that.
2. **Same shape, left alone.** `RecordComments.tsx`'s header (the legacy `DetailView` surface) has its time in a flex row that does not wrap. It is not drawn by the record page this card measured, so it is outside the card. The report records it as a carrier-less note.
